newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Toco shares hit new low on earnings fears.
newsitem.headline: Toco shares hit new low on earnings fears.

text.p: Shares in South African industrial firm Toco Holdings Ltd slid on Thursday amid continuing market worries on the groups' earnings, dealers said.
The firm lost fivets to a new year low of 43 cents. Just last November the firm was trading as high as 380 cents.
The firm issued a profit warning in April, saying that full year attributable earnings had not been as favourableas it had anticipated.
Then on May 29 the firm said it had received an urgent provisional winding-up order for one of its subsidiaries, Inn Group Holdings (Pty) Ltd.
Full details of the effect of the wind-up on the earnings and asset value of Toco will be disclosed when the company publishes its year results at the end of June.
"This firm has been out of favour for months now," one dealer said.
Toco has advised shareholders to exercise caution in dealings in its shares until the publication of results.
